chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sa'dan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I shave every Friday from the first trimming to the second trimming.

key_terms.الطَّلْيَةِ: The trimming (referring to cutting hair, typically mustache or beard)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended grooming practice for Friday according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explicitly mentions his personal practice of shaving the hair between the 'talayata' (interpreted by scholars as the sideburns or the area between the head and beard) every Friday, emphasizing the Sunnah of tidiness for the congregational prayer. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on physical cleanliness (taharah) and aesthetic grooming as acts of worship and respect for the sacred day of Jumu'ah, distinguishing it from mere hygiene.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sa’dan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Every Friday is what is between the trimming to the trimming’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sa’dan from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
I shave every Friday from this to that duration.’”
